dialogues.speaker: Youko
dialogues.text: All good! That Yumekui-Baku lady already looked us over!

dialogues.speaker: Kappa
dialogues.text: We woke up once the Nightmare Fragment was gone... It felt like one big, long dream.

dialogues.speaker: Hitotsume Kozou
dialogues.text: Sorry we couldn't help you with the game, Boss.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Don't worry about it! Besides, there's still time! Why don't you try out "Akitsu Harpastum" and tell me what you think?
